prompt: if i go 5km north at 5km/h then 10km east at 2km/h, how much time will take me to reach my destination
response: To solve this, first calculate the time taken to travel 5km north at 5km/h, which is 1 hour. Then, calculate the time taken to travel 10km east at 2km/h, which is 5 hours. Add these times together to get the total time, which is 6 hours.
